question: Will Bitcoin be above $70,000 on Binance at 7:59 PM EDT on August 21, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the BTC/USDT price on Binance is strictly above $70,000 at the market's settlement time (23:59 UTC on August 21, 2026, equivalent to 7:59 PM EDT).
- "No": Wins if the BTC/USDT price on Binance is at or below $70,000 at the market's settlement time (23:59 UTC on August 21, 2026, equivalent to 7:59 PM EDT).
